{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Security E2E

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'danube-broker/src/**'
      - '.github/workflows/security-e2e.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  security_e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Cache cargo
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq netcat-openbsd protobuf-compiler

      - name: Create certificate files
        run: |
          mkdir -p ./cert
          printf \"%s\" \"${{ secrets.CERT_FILE }}\"> ./cert/server-cert.pem
          printf \"%s\" \"${{ secrets.KEY_FILE }}\"> ./cert/server-key.pem
          printf \"%s\" \"${{ secrets.CA_FILE }}\"> ./cert/ca-cert.pem

      - name: Build unified danube binary
        run: cargo build --release -p danube-broker

      # =====================================================================
      # Start broker with full security enabled
      # =====================================================================
      - name: Start broker (auth.mode=tls)
        env:
          RUST_LOG: info,openraft::replication=off,openraft=error
        run: |
          mkdir -p temp danube-data
          nohup ./target/release/danube up \
            --auth-mode tls \
            --tls-cert ./cert/server-cert.pem \
            --tls-key ./cert/server-key.pem \
            --ca-cert ./cert/ca-cert.pem \
            --jwt-secret your-secret-key \
            --super-admins admin \
            --broker-addr 0.0.0.0:6650 \
            --admin-addr 0.0.0.0:50051 \
            --raft-addr 0.0.0.0:7650 \
            --data-dir ./danube-data/broker-1 \
            --prom-exporter 0.0.0.0:9040 \
            > temp/broker.log 2>&1 &

          # Wait for broker to be ready
          for i in {1..15}; do
            if nc -zv 127.0.0.1 6650 2>/dev/null; then
              echo \"✅ Broker is ready (port 6650).\"
              break
            elif [ $i -eq 15 ]; then
              echo \"❌ Broker failed to start.\"
              cat temp/broker.log
              exit 1
            fi
            echo \"⏳ Waiting for broker to start... ($i/15)\"
            sleep 3
          done

      # =====================================================================
      # Generate JWT tokens for test principals
      # =====================================================================
      - name: Generate JWT tokens
        run: |
          SECRET_KEY=\"your-secret-key\"

          # Super-admin token (subject \"admin\" is in super_admins config)
          ADMIN_TOKEN=$(./target/release/danube ctl security tokens create \
            --subject admin --type user --secret-key \"$SECRET_KEY\")
          echo \"ADMIN_TOKEN=$ADMIN_TOKEN\" >> $GITHUB_ENV

          # Authorized service account token
          AUTHORIZED_TOKEN=$(./target/release/danube ctl security tokens create \
            --subject test-app --type service_account --secret-key \"$SECRET_KEY\")
          echo \"AUTHORIZED_TOKEN=$AUTHORIZED_TOKEN\" >> $GITHUB_ENV

          # Unprivileged token (no bindings will be created for this principal)
          DENIED_TOKEN=$(./target/release/danube ctl security tokens create \
            --subject unprivileged-app --type service_account --secret-key \"$SECRET_KEY\")
          echo \"DENIED_TOKEN=$DENIED_TOKEN\" >> $GITHUB_ENV

          echo \"✅ JWT tokens generated for: admin, test-app, unprivileged-app\"

      # =====================================================================
      # Bootstrap RBAC via super-admin
      # =====================================================================
      - name: Bootstrap RBAC (roles and bindings)
        env:
          DANUBE_ADMIN_ENDPOINT: https://127.0.0.1:50051
          DANUBE_ADMIN_TLS: \"true\"
          DANUBE_ADMIN_CA: ./cert/ca-cert.pem
          DANUBE_ADMIN_TOKEN: ${{ env.ADMIN_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -e
          ADMIN_BIN=\"./target/release/danube ctl\"

          echo \"Token present: $([ -n \"$DANUBE_ADMIN_TOKEN\" ] && echo 'yes' || echo 'NO')\"

          echo \"Creating roles...\"
          $ADMIN_BIN security roles create producer-role --permissions Produce,Lookup
          $ADMIN_BIN security roles create consumer-role --permissions Consume,Lookup

          echo \"\"
          echo \"Verifying roles...\"
          $ADMIN_BIN security roles list --output json

          echo \"\"
          echo \"Pre-creating topic for security tests...\"
          $ADMIN_BIN topics create /default/security-test

          echo \"\"
          echo \"Creating bindings for test-app on /default/security-test...\"
          $ADMIN_BIN security bindings create test-app-produce \
            --principal-type service_account \
            --principal-name test-app \
            --roles producer-role \
            --scope topic \
            --resource /default/security-test

          $ADMIN_BIN security bindings create test-app-consume \
            --principal-type service_account \
            --principal-name test-app \
            --roles consumer-role \
            --scope topic \
            --resource /default/security-test

          echo \"\"
          echo \"Verifying bindings...\"
          $ADMIN_BIN security bindings list --scope topic --resource /default/security-test --output json

          # Allow cache propagation
          sleep 2

          echo \"\"
          echo \"✅ RBAC bootstrap complete\"

      # =====================================================================
      # Run security integration tests
      # =====================================================================
      - name: Run security E2E tests
        env:
          DANUBE_BROKER_ENDPOINT: https://127.0.0.1:6650
          DANUBE_CA_CERT: ../cert/ca-cert.pem
          DANUBE_AUTHORIZED_TOKEN: ${{ env.AUTHORIZED_TOKEN }}
          DANUBE_DENIED_TOKEN: ${{ env.DENIED_TOKEN }}
          RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
        run: |
          cargo test --release -p danube-broker --test security_e2e -- --ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture

      - name: Test online token issue/revoke and last-admin lockout protection
        env:
          DANUBE_ADMIN_ENDPOINT: https://127.0.0.1:50051
          DANUBE_ADMIN_TLS: \"true\"
          DANUBE_ADMIN_CA: ./cert/ca-cert.pem
          DANUBE_ADMIN_TOKEN: ${{ env.ADMIN_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -e
          ADMIN_BIN=\"./target/release/danube ctl\"

          # 1. Online token issuance + revocation
          ISSUED_TOKEN=$($ADMIN_BIN security tokens issue --subject temp-agent --type service_account --ttl 1h)
          if [ -z \"$ISSUED_TOKEN\" ]; then
            echo \"FAIL: issued token was empty\"
            exit 1
          fi
          $ADMIN_BIN security tokens revoke --subject temp-agent
          echo \"✅ Online token issue and revoke verified\"

          # 2. Last-admin lockout protection: revoking the sole active super-admin must fail
          if $ADMIN_BIN security tokens revoke --subject admin; then
            echo \"FAIL: revoking last cluster admin should have been rejected\"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo \"✅ Last-admin lockout protection verified\"

      # =====================================================================
      # Phase 2: Standalone --auth-mode auto-tls zero-secret bootstrap E2E
      # =====================================================================
      - name: \"Phase 2: Stop Phase 1 broker and test --auth-mode auto-tls\"
        run: |
          pkill -x danube || true
          sleep 2

          mkdir -p danube-data/auto-tls temp
          ./target/release/danube up \
            --mode standalone \
            --data-dir ./danube-data/auto-tls \
            --broker-addr 127.0.0.1:6655 \
            --raft-addr 127.0.0.1:7655 \
            --auth-mode auto-tls \
            > temp/broker-auto-tls.log 2>&1 &

          for i in {1..15}; do
            if nc -zv 127.0.0.1 6655 2>/dev/null; then
              echo \"✅ Auto-TLS broker is ready on port 6655.\"
              break
            elif [ $i -eq 15 ]; then
              echo \"❌ Auto-TLS broker failed to start.\"
              cat temp/broker-auto-tls.log
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 2
          done

          test -f ./danube-data/auto-tls/tls/ca.pem
          test -f ./danube-data/auto-tls/bootstrap_admin.token
          PERMS=$(stat -c \"%a\" ./danube-data/auto-tls/bootstrap_admin.token)
          if [ \"$PERMS\" != \"600\" ]; then
            echo \"FAIL: expected 0600 permissions on bootstrap_admin.token, got $PERMS\"
            exit 1
          fi

          BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=$(cat ./danube-data/auto-tls/bootstrap_admin.token)
          DANUBE_ADMIN_ENDPOINT=https://127.0.0.1:6655 \
          DANUBE_ADMIN_TLS=true \
          DANUBE_ADMIN_CA=./danube-data/auto-tls/tls/ca.pem \
          DANUBE_ADMIN_TOKEN=\"$BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN\" \
            ./target/release/danube ctl brokers list
          echo \"✅ Auto-TLS single-port admin connection with bootstrap_admin.token verified\"

      # =====================================================================
      # Cleanup
      # =====================================================================
      - name: Print broker logs on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo '--- broker.log ---'
          cat temp/broker.log || true
          echo '--- broker-auto-tls.log ---'
          cat temp/broker-auto-tls.log || true

      - name: Stop broker
        if: always()
        run: |
          pkill -x danube || true
",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a single security E2E job triggered on pull_request (with path filters) and workflow_dispatch. It already uses a cargo cache and a 15-minute timeout, has no matrix (so fail-fast/failed-job-first do not apply), and has no measured run history (so a history-derived/custom timeout cannot be safely set); Bazel patterns do not apply because this is Rust/cargo. The supported P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE pattern fits: each run represents the same workflow and branch/PR, and a newer push supersedes the older check. Adding a top-level concurrency group keyed by workflow+ref with cancel-in-progress:true cancels stale in-progress runs when a newer revision arrives, while the latest run still executes every build/test step fully, preserving coverage. It is not release/deployment work, and the per-ref group keeps distinct branches from sharing a cancellation group. No permissions, secrets, publishing, deployment, or new network access are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
